cover.title: Lizz Wright
cover.calloutLabel: A note from CEO of Vivo Performing Arts
cover.pressQuote: [Lizz Wright has] …a smooth, dark alto possessed of qualities you might associate with barrel- aged bourbon or butter-soft leather. The New York Times

sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: With a warm, honeyed alto and a folk-inflected jazz band, Lizz Wright creates original songs and covers that reflect the cultural fabric of America, inviting audiences into a musical heartland that makes anyone feel at home.
body: With a warm, honeyed alto that listeners have compared to barrel-aged bourbon and soft leather, Lizz Wright invites you closer, to share the communion and empathy that she extends to rapturous listeners around the world. With a folk-inflected jazz band, she creates original songs and covers that reflect the cultural fabric of America, inviting audiences into a musical heartland that makes anyone feel at home.

bios.name: Lizz Wright
body: With a warm, honeyed alto that listeners have compared to barrel-aged bourbon and soft leather, Lizz Wright invites you closer, to share the communion and empathy that she extends to rapturous listeners around the world. With a folk-inflected jazz band, she creates original songs and covers that reflect the cultural fabric of America, inviting audiences into a musical heartland that makes anyone feel at home.
Vivo Performing Arts gathers and performs on the unceded ancestral lands of the Massachusett, Pawtucket, and Wampanoag peoples.
Assistive listening devices are available. For ASL or audio description on selected performances, contact access@vivoperformingarts.org at least one week in advance.
